title: Microsoft Word for Windows 1.1a, Native X64 Port
summary: A native x64 port of Microsoft Word 1.1a from 1991, enabling the classic 16-bit Windows word processor to run natively on modern 64-bit Windows systems through reverse engineering and code移植, rather than relying on WOW64 compatibility layers.
problem_solved: Enables running vintage Windows 16-bit applications natively on modern 64-bit hardware without emulation overhead.
why_valuable: Preserves software heritage and demonstrates deep technical expertise in Windows architecture, while providing practical value for running legacy applications with better performance.
